themes.name: teamsters strike raises labor costs
themes.description: Teamsters strikes at IKEA, Breakthru Beverage and Transdev increase labor expenses, pressuring margins.

evidence.headline: IKEA TEAMSTERS FORCED TO STRIKE
NEVADA TEAMSTERS LAUNCH STRIKE AT TRANSDEV
BREAKTHRU BEVERAGE TEAMSTERS WIN STRIKE

narrative.thesis: Ongoing Teamsters strikes will raise labor costs for the affected firms, compressing their profit margins.
narrative.why_now: Multiple Teamsters strikes were launched on the same day across three firms.
mechanism_steps: Higher wage and benefit demands increase operating expenses
narrative.falsifier: If the strikes are settled without wage increases, margins would not compress.

reasons: A validator tied the thesis, why-now, mechanism and falsifier to one evidence core.
No thesis-changing evidence arrived in the last 24 hours; the durable proof remains on watch.
3 distinct, supported-source rows carry the same narrative core.
3 of 3 distinct evidence rows repeat at least 2 narrative anchors.
blockers: Needs at least one ticker-linked expression with a causal mechanism and supporting evidence; listing and liquidity are checked later.
